description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing UI state in a React application. It handles sidebar visibility, theme mode, and toast notifications, providing functions to modify and retrieve this state.

methods.name: setSidebarOpen
methods.description: Sets the sidebar open state explicitly.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the UI theme mode ('light' or 'dark').

methods.name: pushToast
methods.description: Adds a toast message to the toasts array, generating a unique id.

methods.name: removeToast
methods.description: Removes a toast message by its id.

methods.name: clearToasts
methods.description: Clears all toast messages from the store.

methods.name: getUIState()
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current UI state.
